```lean
simp only [mul_add, add_mul, one_div] at *,
rw [add_right_inj, add_left_inj],
apply (pow_inj 2).1,
have h : (a + b) * (1 / a + 1 / b) = (a + b) * (b + a) / (a * b),
by simp only [one_div, add_mul, mul_add, div_mul_div],
rw h,
apply (div_le_iff (a * b)).2,
apply mul_pos ha hb,
apply add_le_add_left (le_refl (a + b)) (le_refl (a + b)),
apply le_mul_self (le_add_left ha hb),
apply le_mul_self (le_add_right ha hb),
apply le_add_left ha hb,
apply le_add_right ha hb
```
